rows.title: Party Frontline And Reserve Basics
rows.rules_text: A normal battle party is planned around active frontline members and reserve members. Milestone 4 recommendations should model exactly four frontline heroes and two reserve heroes before sidekick slots are considered.
rows.summary: Use this reference when validating the 4-frontline plus 2-reserve hero contract.
rows.caveats: The recommender is not simulating swaps turn by turn.

rows.title: Main And Sub Sidekick Behavior
rows.rules_text: Treat the main sidekick as the slot that can contribute active sidekick ability value, while a sub sidekick should be valued conservatively for aura-style support. Sidekicks are not heroes and must not occupy frontline or reserve hero slots.
rows.summary: Separates hero slots from main/sub sidekick slots for legal recommendations.
rows.caveats: Sidekick equipment remains outside the active Milestone 4 optimizer scope.

rows.title: Weakness, Resist, Null, And Absorb Handling
rows.rules_text: Lineup scoring should reward attacks that hit a boss weakness and penalize attacks that run into resistance, nullification, or absorption. Missing or unknown affinity data should lower confidence instead of becoming a certainty claim.
rows.summary: Primary affinity grounding for boss-aware offensive fit.
rows.caveats: This is retrieval guidance, not an exact damage calculator.

rows.title: High-Level Damage Multiplier Factors
rows.rules_text: Damage output depends on many stacked factors including skill properties, stats, buffs and debuffs, affinity, weapon and equipment context, critical behavior, and Grasta/Ore setup. Recommendations may discuss these as fit signals but should not claim exact damage without a simulator.
rows.summary: Keeps burst reasoning grounded without pretending to be deterministic.
rows.caveats: Exact numeric damage is explicitly out of scope for Milestone 4.

rows.title: Healing And Sustain Basics
rows.rules_text: Sustain evaluation should look for healing, regeneration, recovery support, defensive setup time, and the ability to keep the party stable through longer fights.
rows.summary: Grounding reference for sustain archetype recommendations.
rows.caveats: Current graph skill text may identify healers without exact healing totals.

rows.title: Buffs, Debuffs, Mitigation, And Resistance Support
rows.rules_text: Defensive fit should value party mitigation, type or physical resistance support, enemy debuffs, and other support that reduces incoming pressure or improves setup safety.
rows.summary: Support grounding for defensive and hybrid lineup reasoning.
rows.caveats: Stacking details should be cited cautiously unless retrieved skill text is explicit.

rows.title: Status Effects, Cleanse, And Protection Relevance
rows.rules_text: When boss mechanics mention harmful statuses, lineup evaluation should value cleanse, immunity, prevention, or flexible recovery. Unsupported status assumptions should be surfaced as risk.
rows.summary: Grounding for status counterplay and risk notes.
rows.caveats: Boss-specific status immunity or success rates may be missing.

rows.title: Zone And Stance Basics
rows.rules_text: Zone and stance effects can meaningfully shape team synergy, damage type preference, and Another Force behavior. Recommendations should prefer lineups whose damage plan and support tools cooperate with the active zone plan.
rows.summary: Grounding for zone-compatible burst, sustain, and hybrid plans.
rows.caveats: The current schema does not introduce Zone nodes.

rows.title: Another Force Basics
rows.rules_text: Burst recommendations may value AF-compatible repeated actions, zone support, weakness pressure, and setup that makes a damage window plausible. They should still avoid exact clear timing claims.
rows.summary: Grounding for fast pressure and AF-window language.
rows.caveats: No turn-by-turn AF simulator is implemented in Milestone 4.

rows.title: Speed, Preemptive, Delayed, And Turn Order Basics
rows.rules_text: Action order can matter for first-turn safety, setup, mitigation, and delayed effects. Recommendations should flag speed or priority assumptions when a plan depends on acting before the boss.
rows.summary: Grounding for speed and timing caveats.
rows.caveats: Fine speed tuning and random variance are not simulated.

rows.title: Stellar Awakening-Gated Skills And Passives
rows.rules_text: If a recommended skill or passive is Stellar Awakening-gated, the legality layer must check the roster's known SA state. Unknown state should be treated conservatively for usable recommendations and labeled as an upgrade assumption when relevant.
rows.summary: Grounding for SA legality and upgrade-burden separation.
rows.caveats: Light/Shadow detail remains deferred unless a specific rule needs it.

rows.title: Grasta And Ore DPS/Support Setup Basics
rows.rules_text: Build notes may assume broad late-game Grasta/Ore access for superboss-oriented users, but rare or specific setup requirements should be labeled. The recommender should not require exact user inventory for every Grasta or Ore in Milestone 4.
rows.summary: Grounding for concise late-game build advice without a full optimizer.
rows.caveats: No exact Grasta/Ore optimizer or inventory model is included in this feature.
